profile.name: 通用Modbus TCP工业设备
profile.description: 这是一类通过 Modbus TCP 通信的工业现场设备，例如温控器、PLC、远程 I/O 模块或电力仪表。它们常用于实验室和测试系统中读取线圈与寄存器数据，并向设备写入开关量或参数设定，实现状态监测、数据采集和过程控制。
profile.description_en: This refers to industrial field devices that communicate over Modbus TCP, such as temperature controllers, PLCs, remote I/O modules, or power meters. In laboratories and test systems, they are commonly used to read coils and registers and to write switching signals or parameter values for monitoring, data acquisition, and process control.
